1.name: The Saturn V Rocket
1.ov: The first episode of the series documents the creation of the iconic Saturn V rocket.

1.name: The Command Module
1.ov: The second episode is centered around the construction of the Apollo Command Module and the setback of the Apollo 1 fire.

1.name: The Navigation Computer
1.ov: The third episode details the story of MIT's work on the Apollo Guidance Computer.

1.name: The Lunar Module
1.ov: The fourth episode features the Grumman project to build mankind's only true spacecraft - the Lunar Module.

1.name: The Space Suit
1.ov: The penultimate episode focuses on the teams that created the remarkable Apollo pressure suit.

1.name: The Lunar Rover
1.ov: The series' final episode centers on the design and perfection of the novel Lunar Roving vehicle carried to the Moon on the Apollo J-class missions.
